shots.prompt: Cinematic 3D animated Hawaiian conservation sanctuary at dawn. Roy, a kind young conservation scientist, walks beneath lush ohia lehua trees carrying a clipboard and fruit while intelligent Hawaiian crows glide overhead. Warm mist, emotional family-film lighting, natural bird anatomy, slow dolly shot.

Two beautiful Hawaiian crows, Kristy with subtle golden-brown sheen and elegant confident posture, Sophi with a soft fluffy crown and energetic expression, perch in tropical foliage and notice each other for the first time. Cinematic 3D animation, expressive but anatomically believable.

Kristy and Sophi joyfully race through branches, dive together toward the forest floor then rocket upward in synchronized flight, playful courtship, cinematic tracking camera, lush Hawaiian sanctuary.

Roy offers bright orange papaya. Kristy lands eagerly on his hand, eats, then carefully saves the last piece and gives it to Sophi. Tender close-ups, warm afternoon sunlight, cinematic 3D animated film.

A conservation release crate opens to a vast Hawaiian forest. Sophi launches first and Kristy follows into open sky, soaring together over valleys and flowering trees. Triumphant cinematic aerial shot, no cages, emotional sense of freedom.

Roy hikes through dense Hawaiian forest holding a radio tracking antenna, increasingly worried as a signal disappears. He spots one black crow high in the branches: Sophi alone. Somber cinematic lighting, restrained emotion.

Back at the sanctuary, Sophi sits alone high in shadowy branches, refusing food, feathers subdued. He releases repeated mournful calls while Roy watches quietly below. Humid dusk, intimate cinematic composition, grief without anthropomorphic tears.

Moonlit sanctuary. Roy places glowing orange papaya between himself and grieving Sophi. Sophi slowly descends, eats every piece except one, then carries the final piece to Roy and drops it at his feet. Roy becomes tearful. Quiet, tender cinematic 3D animation.

Bright morning. Sophi suddenly flies the same joyful loops Kristy once flew, diving and rising through soft green leaves, then gives her distinctive happy call: Ah! Ka ah! Roy runs toward the enclosure and realizes Sophi is remembering her. Emotional uplifting camera movement.

Hopeful future Hawaiian forest with several alala flying freely. A younger crow hears the inherited call Ah! Ka ah! and answers from an ohia branch. Camera rises above a thriving green canopy into golden sky. Poetic conservation ending, cinematic 3D animation.
